ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is a decoder labeled "3:8 Decoder", with input terminals X2, X1, X0, and output terminals labeled in order from OP0 to OP7. On the right side is an encoder labeled "8:3 Encoder", with input terminals labeled in order from IP0 to IP7, and output terminals Y2, Y1, Y0. Each output of the decoder is connected to each input of the encoder through crossed connecting lines. Reasoning: Tracing according to the connections in the figure, OP0 connects to IP0, OP1 connects to IP1, OP2 connects to IP3, OP3 connects to IP2, OP4 connects to IP6, OP5 connects to IP7, OP6 connects to IP5, and OP7 connects to IP4. The 3:8 decoder activates OPn when the binary input is n, and then the 8:3 encoder encodes the activated IPm into output m. Therefore, the overall mapping is 000→000, 001→001, 010→011, 011→010, 100→110, 101→111, 110→101, 111→100. This is exactly the standard conversion table from 3-bit binary code to Gray code, so this circuit is a binary-to-Gray-code converter.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: identify the left block as a 3:8 decoder receiving X2, X1, X0 and the right block as an 8:3 encoder producing Y2, Y1, Y0, with the decoder outputs cross-connected to encoder inputs. Then trace each active decoder output OPn to its encoder input IPm to form the mapping from binary input n to output code m. The traced mapping is 000→000, 001→001, 010→011, 011→010, 100→110, 101→111, 110→101, 111→100. Recognize this as the standard binary-to-Gray conversion table, so identify the circuit as a Binary to Gray code converter.

推理：按图中连线追踪，OP0 接 IP0，OP1 接 IP1，OP2 接 IP3，OP3 接 IP2，OP4 接 IP6，OP5 接 IP7，OP6 接 IP5，OP7 接 IP4。3:8 译码器在二进制输入为 n 时激活 OPn，随后 8:3 编码器把被激活的 IPm 编成输出 m。因此整体映射为 000→000，001→001，010→011，011→010，100→110，101→111，110→101，111→100。这正是 3 位二进制码到格雷码的标准转换表，所以该电路是二进制到格雷码转换器。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Uses the actual interconnection pattern between the 3-to-8 decoder and 8-to-3 encoder to derive the implemented input-output code mapping, rather than relying only on recognizing block names.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the circuit as a 3-input block with inputs X2, X1, X0 feeding a 3:8 decoder whose outputs OP0–OP7 are rewired into an 8:3 encoder inputs IP0–IP7, producing Y2, Y1, Y0. Note the permutation of decoder outputs into encoder inputs: OP0→IP0, OP1→IP1, OP2→IP3, OP3→IP2, OP4→IP6, OP5→IP7, OP6→IP5, OP7→IP4.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the text only to determine the requested task: name or identify the shown circuit.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: A 3:8 decoder activates one minterm line corresponding to the binary input value. An 8:3 encoder outputs the binary index of whichever input line is active. Therefore the wiring permutation directly defines the output code. The sequence 0,1,3,2,6,7,5,4 is the 3-bit Gray-code order for binary inputs 0 through 7.
